navigationMode.title: Navigation Mode
navigationMode.description: Forces how UltraForce opens Salesforce pages. Values: auto (follow user preference), lightning (always Lightning Experience), classic (always Salesforce Classic).

hideManagedPackage.title: Hide Managed Package Items
hideManagedPackage.description: When true, managed package metadata items are hidden from search results; when false, they are always shown.

maxResultsPerType.title: Max Results Per Type
maxResultsPerType.description: Maximum number of search results returned per metadata type. Capped between 10 and 500 to bound API usage.
